snippet.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Xenoblade Chronicles 3 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition launches Deccember 3, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/xenoblade-chronicles-3-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Defeat as many waves of enemies as you can in the new Heroes' Vault mode. Strengthen your forces as you play by enhancing their abilities or gaining additional allies. 

Plus, team up with a new hero, Shimmer, an Attacker with rapid-fire combos, powerful strikes, and the Foresight ability that allows her to see the future. 

Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Xenoblade Chronicles 3 on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition by purchasing the upgrade pack.

#NintendoDirect #XenobladeChronicles3
